label: ercot129 conditional coal min
definition: ERCOT-129: the ercot115 keeper recipe with a single delta, ercot_coal_min_config_floor armed in its availability-CONDITIONAL form — a coal plant may not run below the registered minimum load of its smallest online configuration (EIA-860 Minimum Load, 10 plants / 2,164 MW), applied plant-wide-or-nothing with the level reallocated across available coal tranches, replacing the LP's previously-unbounded per-plant coal floor. This removes a structural falsehood rather than closing a residual: physically-impossible online plant-hours (below each plant's own min-configuration while online) fall 14,582->2,074 (2023), 13,020->3,262 (2024), 9,558->1,240 (2025) versus the outgoing keeper, while D-2 attributes coal_min_config 3.198/2.872/2.546 TWh forced (5.26/4.92/4.17% of coal, inside the 30% cap) and D-4 clears 0.0% off-window in all three years (window h0-23). DOF cost is zero: the ledger grows 10->11 entries with the residual count unchanged at 8, the new entry measured-physical with 0 residual solves. Rubric profile is identical to the outgoing keeper (C1 all 16/16, free 12/12; C2/C4/C8 PASS; C3a/C3b/C3c/C7 FAIL; C6 UNATTESTED) — determination remains NOT-YET. Supersedes 2026-07-26-ercot115-coal-marginal-hr.
